finding: The air at Chicago's bus stops is dirtiest in the morning rush. At 7 a.m. on weekdays it holds about 44% more nitrogen dioxide than at 1 p.m., the cleanest hour. The worst of it lies over the Loop and the Southwest and West Sides.

ledger.source: Open Air Chicago (Chicago Department of Public Health; UIC School of Public Health), hour aggregations
method: Median per sensor, weekdays 7-9 a.m. local, Nov 2025 - Oct 2026
Gaussian kernel surface, sigma 0.6 mi; drawn where it weighs one sensor at 1.25 mi
Contours every 1 ppb, lit from the northwest (Tanaka)
caveats: Non-regulatory sensors; collocated sensors differ by up to 3.2 ppb
A smoothed surface: values between sensors are estimates
